finding: Model API key committed in the prototype repo history
fix_note: Rotate the key, purge it from the repo history, and move all customer-environment secrets into the customer's own vault with per-environment entries.

finding: A pasted discharge note can inject instructions that override the retrieval filter
fix_note: Treat all pasted and retrieved text as data, never as instructions: delimit it, strip instruction-shaped spans, and add the injection cases to the FDE 2.05 eval set as a release gate.

finding: Trace payloads from the FDE 2.07 observability build log full patient identifiers
fix_note: Redact identifiers before the trace write, keep only the fields the FDE 2.07 alerts actually read, and purge the identifier-bearing traces already stored.

finding: The eval dataset was copied to a vendor region outside the customer's residency zone
fix_note: Delete the out-of-zone copy, re-home the eval set inside the residency zone, and record the dataset's permitted regions in the engagement decision log.

blocker: Needs a contract amendment with the sub-processor; the customer's procurement team owns the signature.
finding: Prompt payloads are retained for ninety days by a sub-processor
fix_note: Amend the sub-processor terms to zero retention for this customer's payloads, or route the traffic to the no-retention endpoint.

blocker: Needs the customer's identity team to issue the IdP application registration; the engagement cannot create it.
finding: A shared ward login bypasses per-user audit; real single sign-on is still not live
fix_note: Replace the shared login and the FDE 2.08 stand-in screen with the customer's real IdP, per-user sessions, and role checks on every endpoint.

finding: A retrieved document can instruct the model to reveal another patient's brief
fix_note: Enforce the restricted-document filter outside the model, so a document's text cannot widen its own audience; add cross-patient cases to the eval gate.

finding: Customer database credentials sit in a plain env file on the build laptop
fix_note: Move the credentials into the vault, issue a least-privilege build identity, and rotate the exposed password.

finding: The audit log is editable by the application admin; it is not tamper-evident
fix_note: Append-only writes with hash chaining, and admin access separated from log custody.

finding: Nightly backups replicate to a second region by default
fix_note: Pin backups to the residency zone and delete the out-of-zone replicas.

finding: Feedback free-text can contain patient names and is stored unreviewed
fix_note: Warn at the input, screen on write, and review the stored feedback corpus once for names already captured.

finding: The prototype endpoints are unauthenticated on the customer LAN
fix_note: Put every endpoint behind the engagement's interim per-user token check now; the full IdP replacement stays with F06 when the customer unblocks it.

finding: Tool-call arguments are built from ticket free-text without validation
fix_note: Validate every tool argument against its schema and allow-list before the call, in the FDE 2.04 exposure layer.

finding: Test fixtures contain copied real-format patient identifiers
fix_note: Replace the fixtures with synthetic identifiers from the generator and scan the repo for the copied pattern.
